🚨Pepper-Sprayed, Beaten for No Helmet — Dies step
In Huayang County, "Hunan Province", a villager named Xiao Chuncai was chased home by two traffic officers for riding a bike without a helmet. Upon reaching his doorstep, officers allegedly pepper-sprayed and beat him with batons—he died on the spot.

Enraged villagers surrounded the officers. That night, a large contingent of police forcibly removed the two from the village.

💥 No trial. No justice. Just terror in uniform.

#CommunistChina 
#HumanRights
